task: W69 original Ammit AR2 model identity, rig, animation and component audit
scope: Local private original sources only; no gameplay video research, geometry partition/generator/runtime implementation, GUI/MCP interaction, client launch, normal QA, source save, or commit.

private_archive.note: Current local hash only; no expected archive hash supplied.

method.raw_fbx_check: Bundled io_scene_fbx.parse_fbx.parse; inspected actual Objects records for animation, rig/deformer and Model subtypes.
method.animation_check: Enumerated all bpy.data ID collections and embedded node trees for animation_data, all actions including layers/channelbags and legacy fcurves, object animation/constraints/modifiers, armatures/bones, NLA tracks/strips, drivers and shape keys.
method.why_fresh_inspection_required: Cached W30 audit recorded mesh/material data only; cached FBX inspector and reconstruction use use_anim=False, which cannot establish absence of animation.

shader_motion_exception.interpretation: Frame-dependent material texture-coordinate motion; no mesh, bone, or reload keyframes. Expression read as data with autoexec disabled; playback not evaluated.

w30_reconciliation.textured_triangles_note: Historical generation count, not a current texture-availability assertion.
w30_reconciliation.fbx_roundoff_note: Imported FBX bounds have small floating point/axis conversion differences; matching counts do not assert byte-identical geometry.

reload_findings.basis: Both original formats inspected with animation enabled/retained: no action, action curve, NLA strip, armature, bone, shape key or object transform animation. Raw FBX contains no Animation* objects or Deformer/Pose records.
reload_findings.qualification: The blend is not entirely time-independent: Fluid has one frame-driven shader Mapping socket. All 13 meshes retain null-target Armature modifiers and 80 vertex groups; those remnants do not supply a usable rig or reload motion.

magazine.observation: Already a separate rigid mesh, but its source origin is shared world zero rather than a demonstrated magazine/socket pivot; no extraction path, timing or reload transform is stored.

middle_utility_group.observation: A bounded named subset for the main geometry owner to inspect if useful. No claim that it is a bolt, charging handle, or moving reload component; there is no target skeleton or motion track.

reload_findings.limits: Absence of a separately named part does not establish absence of that geometry within Middle/Main - Body/Inner Structure. Hand poses, reload timing, bolt motion and partition choices require independent reference/implementation work owned by main.

material_findings.fbx_material_graph_note: FBX importer produced material names but no connected image texture nodes or source node groups; prefer blend graph evidence for source material assignments.
material_findings.source_color_note: Main/Middle/Magazine/Stock/Sights/Inner Structure/Inner Omolon Logo have Diffuse/Normal/GStack image nodes plus dye/playergear groups. Fluid, Fluid Glass and Barrel Tube use distinct graphs, so diffuse-only or single-material assumptions lose source information. No source materials were rebaked or changed.
